//: Flutter web cannot be built by Vercel's builders. This project is deployed manually from vercel_out/ (see scripts/build-web.sh). That directory is gitignored, so a git-triggered build from this repo has nothing to publish. Disabling git deployments is what stops that. It is false for every branch, not just main: naming main left every feature branch firing a preview build that could only ever fail, which is where the red Error rows in the Vercel dashboard came from.
